GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 14 January 2026
Showery condition over the island is expected to reduce from tomorrow (15th)
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Kaluthara, Galle, Matara and Rathnapura
districts after 4.00 p.m.
Mainly fair weather will prevail elsewhere.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central and
Northwestern provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
